title: Seeking to duration with no buffer while in ended state (avc-50fps-cbr-hd)
product-requirement: Client must have access to expected events and properties after seeking to duration while MediaSource is in the ended state, and one of two buffers is empty.
specification: Terminals MUST implement Media Source Extensions API (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values.
